summary: Establish rotating contractor license pool and temporary seat governance for Q2 research sprint
description:
Issue summary: The Applied Research team will run a 6-week Q2 sprint (Apr 6–May 15) that requires temporary access for ~35 contractors across a mix of SaaS tools (JetBrains, Notion, Sentry, PostHog, GitHub, and a short-term eval on Pinecone). We need a centralized, rotating license pool and a lightweight governance process so we can provision seats quickly, ensure secure offboarding, and attribute costs to the correct cost centers.

Impact: Without a pooled approach, research will be delayed while we onboard contractors individually. Manual provisioning risks inconsistent RBAC, missed offboarding, and duplicate invoices charged to multiple departments. Estimated incremental spend: ~$18k for 6 weeks if we provision dedicated seats per contractor (vs target pooled discount and share model of ~$9k).

Requirements / Acceptance criteria:
- Create a temporary contractor seat pool (35 seats) for the stated 6-week window with start/end automation and hard expiry.
- Prefer solutions that support SCIM/SCIM-like automated provisioning for JetBrains/Notion/GitHub where available.
- Implement automated offboarding task triggered by seat expiry and a weekly verification report.
- All purchases must be tagged with Redwood cost center tags and assigned to Finance PO-2026-Q2-RESEARCH.
- Security review checklist completed (MFA enforced, limited org admin rights, SSO where supported).
- Procurement to secure trial/temporary bulk-license discount where possible and provide invoice to Finance for centralized payment.

Timeline: Request approvals by 2026-03-18 so procurement can finalize vendor agreements by 2026-03-25 and provisioning can begin by 2026-04-01.

Notes: Research lead requests priority provisioning for 5 "team leads" who need org-admin in certain tools (JetBrains repo & GitHub org). All other contractors should be granted contributor-level access only.
steps_taken: Initial self-serve requests were attempted through vendor portals but seat limits and billing constraints blocked bulk checkout; reached out to vendor sales for temporary license quotes (JetBrains sales case #JB-98172). Raised preliminary budget ask with Finance (Slack #finance).
